'''Tavoy''' was the name of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Grey Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point between [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Tavoy participated in a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to track the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, the pilot was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Detonation pack|explosive device]] planted onto Tavoy's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] by an [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|Imperial saboteur]].

==Biography==
===Service to the New Republic===
{{Quote|Imperials and Sith&hellip;Can this place get any worse?|Shara, upon encountering Nightsisters at X1's abandoned base on Dathomir|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:Grey_squadron_formation.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tavoy was a member of Grey Squadron.]]
Tavoy was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who became a member of [[Grey Squadron]], a [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]] unit commanded by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[X2]].<ref name="ES" /> Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Grey [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] participated in a hunt for X2's brother, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[X1]]. After receiving [[New Republic Intelligence Service|intelligence]] reports that X1 operated from a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], X2 led Tavoy and the rest of the squadron on a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] there.<ref name="ES" />

The squadron journeyed to Dathomir in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] and landed in the middle of the planet's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] to avoid detection. The pilots soon found an Imperial [[X1's Dathomir base|base]] that had belonged to X1. However, the base had been abandoned by the Empire, and it was being overrun by another faction, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan of the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]], who battled the few remaining Imperials inside the base's premises.<ref name="ES" />

===Victim of a terrorist===
{{Quote|What the&mdash;What happened here&hellip;?!''"<br />"''It looks like someone planted detpacks on our ships, sir.|X2 and a member of Grey Squadron|<ref name="ES" />}}
Tavoy and most of the squadron remained with their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] at the landing site, while X2 and three other squadron members cleared out the base from both the Nightsisters and [[X1's faction|X1's forces]]. X2 and Grey Squadron member [[Shara]] then went inside the base to extract data from X1's personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="ES" />

[[File:X2_Force_choke.jpg|thumb|right|250px|X2 Force-choked the Imperial saboteur responsible for Tavoy's death.]]
While X2 and Shara were away, [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|one of X1's Imperials]] infiltrated the squadron's landing site and attached [[detonation pack]]s on the squadron's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. The explosives then detonated, inflicting heavy casualties for Grey Squadron. Tavoy was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the blasts alongside other pilots, including [[Watkins]] and [[Ryder]].<ref name="ES" />

The survivors of the attack managed to capture the Imperial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]]. When X2 and Shara returned to the landing site, they were horrified to witness the result of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] act. Angered at the loss of Tavoy and the other pilots, X2 was overwhelmed with emotion and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] the Imperial, before Shara calmed him down. The survivors of Grey Squadron then destroyed an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet and left Dathomir to continue their search for X1.<ref name="ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tavoy was featured in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', developed by [[N-Space|N-space]] and released in [[2009]]. Tavoy was briefly mentioned as one of the Grey Squadron pilots killed during the mission to Dathomir, and neither the character's [[Species/Legends|species]] nor gender was established in the game.<ref name="ES" />
